app_type: Interactive Comparison Panel (Web Feature within existing Lease Portal)
summary: Manual preparation of lease comparisons in PowerPoint and Excel is time-consuming, inconsistently formatted, and lacks real-time adjustability for major client meetings.
requirement_text:
Organisation: CBRE — Advisory & Transaction Services (India)
Segment: Commercial Real Estate — Office Leasing Advisory

AI SUGGESTED & EDITED PARAMETERS:
APP TYPE: Interactive Comparison Panel integrated into the existing Lease Portal
SEGMENT: Commercial Real Estate — Office Leasing Advisory
PROBLEM: Manual preparation of lease comparisons in PowerPoint and Excel is time-consuming, inconsistently formatted, and lacks real-time adjustability for major client meetings.
SOLUTION: Integrate a live rent comparison panel within the CBRE Lease Portal to provide side-by-side comparisons of shortlisted buildings, supporting live data adjustments during client meetings and consistent presentation formats.
TOOLS AND TECH STACKS: React, TypeScript, Azure, REST APIs, D3.js for data visualization, SharePoint Integration for data conversion
EXPECTED OUTCOME: Reduce broker preparation time from 6-10 hours to 30 minutes per shortlist, enable live adjustments during client meetings, ensure consistent presentation formatting across all brokers.
TARGET USER SPECIFICATION: CBRE India brokers who are primarily non-technical users but require efficient and consistent client presentation tools.
REGULATORY

Log every decision/response immutably for audit.
Produce cluster/anomaly assignments with a quality score.
Persist the fitted model + assignment for each input row.
